 back, in an inverted order, aside, towards’. According to <ls>G. M.</ls> the senses
 of {#parA#} are:--
.²1 killing, injuring & ({#parAhata#}).
.²2 going ({#parAgata#}).
.²3 seeing, encountering ({#parAdfzwa#}).
.²4 prowess ({#parAkrAnta#}).
.²5 direction towards ({#parAvftta#}).
.²6 excess ({#parAjita#}).
.²7 dependence ({#parADIna#}).
.²8 liberation ({#parAkfta#}).
.²9 inverted order, backwards ({#parANmuKa#}).
.²10 setting aside, disregarding.
